title: Taurus: rebuilding the routine
old_caption: When the routine falls apart, start with one tiny thing. Water the plant, fold one sock, let a friend bring stew on the bad day. Watch what grows back.

title: Pisces: the 30-day finale
old_caption: Thirty days, twelve friends, a lot of tears. Pisces heals the way most of us do: with people who show up, especially on the bad days. Tag the friend on your rota.

title: Nine Invites
old_caption: When every weekend in December fills up, it's easy to forget you're allowed to say no. Pick the gatherings you'd truly miss, send a warm note to the rest, and keep one day just for rest.

title: Small Budget, Big Heart
old_caption: Worried your gift isn't big enough? The ones people keep are the ones that prove you were listening. Think back to something they loved this year and make it personal.

title: Plus-One Short
old_caption: Walking into a party of couples on your own can feel lonely for about five minutes. You're not missing a half. Go say hi to someone new, and maybe the host's dog.

title: Social Battery: 2%
old_caption: If the party is loud and you're running on empty, you don't have to hide in the coat pile. Tell someone you're stepping out for ten quiet minutes, then come back when you're ready.

title: Out of Office
old_caption: Still answering work messages at the holiday table? Set the auto-reply and trust it. The work will wait for you, and the people beside you are only here for a little while.

title: It's a Gift Swap, Not a Final
old_caption: Gift swaps get competitive fast. The best part was never the prize: it's laughing together when the plan falls apart. Play to have fun, and let the candle go.

title: Guests in Ten Minutes
old_caption:
Hosting doesn't mean doing it all yourself. When guests offer to help, say yes: most people love having a small job. A kitchen full of friends is the whole point.
Save this for your next dinner.

title: Delayed. Again.
old_caption: Travel delays can leave you apologising to everyone, even the departure board. A delay isn't your fault. Send one kind update home, find a snack, and let yourself rest.
